25d2f85274df1a07f33401872dc4a3c1a5dad0ec.rationale: positive immunostaining for α-smooth muscle actin, vimentin, and desmin, which are characteristic of leiomyosarcoma

Leiomyosarcoma: F12: Differential diagnosis: primary lymphoma, metastasis, and sarcoma (although leiomyosarcoma is a type of sarcoma)
F5: Chief complaint: rapidly enlarging right parietal mass behind the ear over one month
F8: Noncontrast CT of the head: 5-cm hyperdense meningeal mass with parietal bone invasion
F9: Gadolinium-enhanced MRI: heterogeneously enhancing lesion in the right parietal region
F10: Cerebral angiography: vascular tumor supplied by the middle meningeal artery
F16: Histology: malignant spindle cell neoplasm
F17: Immunostaining: positive for α-smooth muscle actin, vimentin, and desmin
